page: Amazon Web Services c8g.metal-24xl is a bare-metal, compute-optimized server powered by 96 dedicated physical cores of the AWS Graviton Neoverse-V2 processor. Operating on the arm64 architecture at 2.8 GHz, this server features a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio with no hyperthreading. It is equipped with 192.0 GB of DDR5 memory, providing 2.0 GB of RAM per core. The processor includes 36 MB of L3 cache, 2 MB of L2 cache per core, and 64 KB of L1d cache. There is no local storage or GPU hardware bundled with this instance, and it delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 40 Gbps.

Benchmark results show top-tier multi-core performance, with stress-ng multi-core CPU scoring 163903.0 and Geekbench multi-core reaching 26474.0. Memory bandwidth is exceptionally strong, registering 11096.49 GB/sec for cached small-block reads and 481.1 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads. The server also demonstrates top-tier efficiency in database operations, achieving 196.18 million operations per second in Redis SET tests and 47205.61 in Passmark database operations. However, single-core performance is more moderate, with stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the average and strong tiers respectively.

The absence of local storage and dedicated GPU hardware limits this server's utility for local-disk-heavy databases or GPU-accelerated deep learning. However, its high core density and memory bandwidth make it highly efficient for multi-threaded workloads. It is suited for static web serving, software compilation, multi-threaded decompression, and CPU-based LLM text generation for medium to large models, where it achieves strong relative performance. The bare-metal architecture provides direct hardware access, eliminating hypervisor overhead for compute-intensive deployments.
description: Amazon Web Services c8g.metal-24xl is a bare-metal, compute-optimized server featuring 96 dedicated physical cores on the ARMv9 AWS Graviton Neoverse-V2 processor. Operating at 2.8 GHz with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, it includes 192.0 GB of DDR5 memory, 36 MB of L3 cache, and a baseline network bandwidth of 40 Gbps. The server lacks local storage and GPU accelerators. In benchmarks, the c8g.metal-24xl delivers top-tier multi-core CPU performance, high memory bandwidth, and exceptional throughput for database operations, such as Redis SET tasks. Conversely, single-core performance and text processing benchmarks fall into average ranges. This bare-metal instance is designed for highly parallelized workloads, including software compilation, multi-threaded decompression, static web serving, and CPU-based LLM text generation, offering high resource density and direct hardware access without hypervisor overhead.
